_note: Every item type. category drives the inventory screen and storage rules. shelf_days: spoils in ordinary storage (see AAA_DESIGN §3). value: relative worth for scores and supply runs. Food values are in dishes.json. 'one'/'plural': the name for one unit and for several units in texts (default: the name).

ore.name: Iron ore
ore.desc: Mined from mineral deposits. A refinery turns 2 ore into 1 steel.

silicate.name: Silicate sand
silicate.desc: Scooped from the ground by a regolith harvester. Makes glass and electronics.

exotic.name: Exotic crystal
exotic.desc: Rare crystal from deep under the surface. Needed for special research and level 5 upgrades.

glass.name: Glass
glass.desc: For domes, windows and ship systems.

polymer.name: Polymer
polymer.desc: Plastic made from biomass. The second building material.

biomass.name: Biomass
biomass.desc: Plant waste from every harvest. A polymer plant turns 2 biomass into 1 polymer.

spare_parts.name: Spare parts
spare_parts.desc: One part repairs 25 health of a structure. Ship maintenance uses them too.

electronics.name: Electronics
electronics.desc: Circuit boards. Needed for level 3 and higher, advanced buildings and the ship.

outpost_kit.name: Outpost Kit
outpost_kit.desc: A folded outpost core. A medium rover carries it; deployed, it starts a new base with air for three days.

hull_plate.name: Hull plate
hull_plate.desc: Armoured plate for the Meridian's hull.

composite.name: Composite panel
composite.desc: Light, strong panel. Needed for level 4 and higher and the ship engines.

rocket_fuel.name: Rocket fuel
rocket_fuel.desc: Hydrogen and oxygen fuel. Fuels the Meridian and its supply runs.

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.desc: Doubles healing in a medical bay. Cures sickness from bad nutrition.

water.name: Water can
water.desc: Carried water. It enters the network when it is delivered to a reservoir.

potato.name: Potato
potato.desc: Rich in carbs. Grows in a greenhouse.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.desc: Carbs and some protein. Keeps well.

mushroom.name: Mushroom
mushroom.desc: Grows in the dark in a fungus farm. Protein and taste.

algae.name: Algae
algae.desc: Grown in a bioreactor. High protein.

herbs.name: Herbs
herbs.desc: Spices and herbs. Small food value, large taste.

meals.name: Emergency ration
meals.desc: Sealed ration from the lander. Balanced, but bland.

algae_bar.name: Algae protein bar
algae_bar.desc: High protein. Tastes of the sea.

colony_feast.name: Colony feast
colony_feast.desc: A celebration of everything the colony grows.

pack_basic.name: Basic research pack
pack_basic.desc: Made from water and power in a research assembler. Tier 2 and 3 research needs it. A lab that has the packs of its project works twice as fast.

pack_applied.name: Applied research pack
pack_applied.desc: Made from glass, electronics and water. Tier 3 and 4 research needs it.

pack_exotic.name: Exotic research pack
pack_exotic.desc: Made from exotic crystal, composite and electronics. Special research (tier 5) needs it. Meteor fragments sometimes hold one.

ice.name: Water ice
ice.desc: Mined from ice deposits. Melts into water; the chemical plant makes coolant and acid from it.

titanium_ore.name: Titanium ore
titanium_ore.desc: Mined on plateaus. A titanium smelter turns 3 ore into 1 titanium.

carbon_ore.name: Carbon ore
carbon_ore.desc: Mined at crevice edges. Makes graphite and alloy steel.

uranium_ore.name: Uranium ore
uranium_ore.desc: Mined in radiation fields. Chemistry turns it into yellowcake, then fuel rods. Radioactive.

thorium_ore.name: Thorium ore
thorium_ore.desc: Mined in radiation fields. A second way to make fuel rods. Radioactive.

he3_regolith.name: Helium-3 regolith
he3_regolith.desc: Cold dust from deep crater floors. A separator takes the helium-3 from it.

rare_earth_ore.name: Rare-earth ore
rare_earth_ore.desc: Mined on crevice floors. Makes magnets and superconductors.

slag.name: Slag
slag.desc: Left over from smelting. The chemical plant makes acid from it; a ceramics kiln fires it into ceramic.

alloy.name: Alloy steel
alloy.desc: Hard carbon steel. Rover parts, magnets and advanced research packs need it.

titanium.name: Titanium
titanium.desc: Light and strong. Titanium hull plates, fuel rods and helium-3 fuel need it.

ceramic.name: Ceramic
ceramic.desc: Heat-proof. Superconductors, thorium rods and advanced research packs need it.

graphite.name: Graphite
graphite.desc: Pure carbon. Makes carbon fibre and graphene.

acid.name: Acid
acid.desc: From slag and ice. Batteries and ore chemistry need it. Keep it off the ground.

coolant.name: Coolant
coolant.desc: From ice and polymer. Superconductors, graphene, crystal lattices and reactors need it.

yellowcake.name: Yellowcake
yellowcake.desc: Uranium concentrate. A fuel rod plant makes fuel rods from it. Radioactive.

he3_gas.name: Helium-3 gas
he3_gas.desc: Rare fusion fuel gas, taken from crater dust.

rare_earth_oxide.name: Rare-earth oxide
rare_earth_oxide.desc: Refined rare earths. Makes magnets and superconductors.

graphene.name: Graphene
graphene.desc: One-atom carbon sheet. Makes the best electronics and metamaterials.

purified_crystal.name: Purified crystal
purified_crystal.desc: Exotic crystal cleaned with acid. Grows into crystal lattices.

crystal_lattice.name: Crystal lattice
crystal_lattice.desc: Grown exotic crystal. Metamaterials need it. Unstable to make.

superconductor.name: Superconductor
superconductor.desc: Wire with no resistance when cold. Deep research and metamaterials need it.

metamaterial.name: Metamaterial
metamaterial.desc: The highest product of the colony. Its uses come with the later research.

battery_cell.name: Battery cell
battery_cell.desc: Advanced research packs and rovers need it.

rover_parts.name: Rover parts
rover_parts.desc: Wheels, motors and frames for vehicles.

fuel_rod.name: Fuel rod
fuel_rod.desc: Fuel for the fission reactor. Radioactive.

he3_fuel.name: Helium-3 fuel
he3_fuel.desc: Sealed fusion fuel. For the fusion reactor in later research.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.desc: Strong rare-earth magnet. For motors, reactors and the tier-3 research.

pack_advanced.name: Advanced research pack
pack_advanced.desc: Made from alloy steel, ceramic and a battery cell. Tier 4 research of the V4 branches needs it.

pack_deep.name: Deep research pack
pack_deep.desc: Made from superconductor, graphene and electronics (or from a data core). The high-end research needs it.

data_core.name: Data core
data_core.desc: Found at wrecks and derelict probes. A research assembler turns one into three deep research packs.

derelict_parts.name: Derelict parts
derelict_parts.desc: Found at wrecks. A workshop salvages spare parts and electronics from them.

meteorite_sample.name: Meteorite sample
meteorite_sample.desc: Found in meteorite fields. Holds exotic crystal (a chemical plant purifies it).

blueprint_fragment.name: Blueprint fragment
blueprint_fragment.desc: Found in derelict probes. A research assembler makes three advanced research packs from one.

snacks.name: Snacks
snacks.desc: Crisps and sweets from the distillery. Cafes, the grocery and parties use them.

drinks.name: Drinks
drinks.desc: Brewed at the distillery. The bar, the Club and parties use them.

clothing.name: Clothing
clothing.desc: Casual wear from the workshop. Shops sell it; people like new clothes.

gifts.name: Gifts
gifts.desc: Small presents from the workshop. Shops sell them; the Gift order uses one.

gadgets.name: Gadgets
gadgets.desc: Games and devices from the electronics fab. The electronics shop sells them.

luxury_goods.name: Luxury goods
luxury_goods.desc: Fine goods from the fabricator. Shops sell them to colonists and tourists.
